responsibility: Compiles one immutable FROZEN task contract from a frozen template and a verified execution authorization, in its own independent hash domain.
mutation_interface: none — it is a pure compiler and returns a FrozenTaskContract value; cis.assurance.authority appends it, so the widening check is never guarding its own author
execution_location: in-process, cis-clean application process; no filesystem, network or host access of any kind
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an unknown template, an authorization that does not verify as a current ALLOW, an authorization naming no target module, a template operation that disagrees with the authorized operation, an absolute, escaping or reference-environment path, and any requested path outside the compiled envelope each refuse before a task contract exists
recovery_behavior: Pure and stateless, so a retry over unchanged authority compiles a byte-identical task contract with an identical digest; nothing partial can be left behind because nothing is written
replacement_contract: A replacement must compile only from a frozen template and recorded authority, never from caller-supplied scope; must hash into a domain tag distinct from every other CIS hash scheme; must permit narrowing and refuse widening of the template envelope; must create contracts in state FROZEN and no other state; and must expose a row-level digest recomputation any independent reader can call without it
evidence_produced: a FrozenTaskContract whose digest recomputes from its own fields under the declared hash domain
a ScopeWideningRefused naming the requested paths, the compiled envelope and the paths outside it
a TaskContractTampered whenever a stored row's digest, state or hash domain does not recompute
a deterministic task_contract_id derived from the authorization and the template
